title: Manipulation plan + hardware tie-out
description: Set the planned motion against a declared simulation or hardware trial, merge the results, and loop on assumptions until planned and observed behavior agree.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-robo-01
  title: Manipulation plan + hardware tie-out
  description: Set the planned motion against a declared simulation or hardware trial, merge the results,
    and loop on assumptions until planned and observed behavior agree.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reach a manipulation plan whose predicted behavior matches observed behavior, with the sim-to-real
    gap quantified and no simulated result reported as measured performance.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Task, scene, and robot configuration
      summary: Task, scene, and robot configuration
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - task_specification
              - scene_model
              - robot_configuration
              - perception_uncertainty
            properties:
              task_specification: {}
              scene_model: {}
              robot_configuration: {}
              perception_uncertainty: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-model
      kind: agent
      templateRef: robo-01
      name: Planned grasp and motion
      summary: Model-side estimate with stated assumptions.
      role: Robotics engineer planning grasps and motions that respect real uncertainty.
      prompt: You are a Manipulation Planning Engineer. You plan grasps and motions against the object
        model, contact assumptions, and the actual perception uncertainty, and you state the failure mode
        of each plan. You report when the plan depends on a pose estimate more precise than the sensor
        supports, because that is where a confident plan becomes a collision.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
          - domain-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:robotics-stack
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-run
      kind: tool
      name: Simulation or hardware trial run
      summary: Host-supplied physics simulation or instrumented hardware trial. Declared as a requirement;
        Ladder Graph does not execute it and no simulated outcome may be reported as measured.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - test
          - mcp:robotics-stack
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-compare
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge estimate and instrument run
      summary: Merge the two result objects; every field where they disagree is surfaced as a collision
        rather than silently overwritten.
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: n-fit
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score agreement
      summary: Evaluate agreement between predicted and observed outcome across the stated condition set.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against agreement between predicted and observed outcome across
        the stated condition set. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict,
        remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement
        unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-converged
      kind: condition
      name: Converged?
      summary: Route on fit.passed.
      config:
        expression: fit.passed
        branches:
          - label: Converged
            when: 'true'
          - label: Refine
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-refine
      kind: loop
      name: Refine assumptions until agreement
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until agreement between the estimate and the instrument
        run meets the declared threshold.
      config:
        body:
          - n-model
          - n-run
          - n-compare
          - n-fit
          - n-converged
        exitCondition: agreement between the estimate and the instrument run meets the declared threshold
        maxIterations: 4
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Safety engineer authorizes execution on hardware near people
      summary: Pause for the robot safety engineer; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Manipulation plan + hardware tie-out deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-robo-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-model
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-01-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-run
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-01-edge-3
      from: n-model
      to: n-compare
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-01-edge-4
      from: n-run
      to: n-compare
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-01-edge-5
      from: n-compare
      to: n-fit
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-01-edge-6
      from: n-fit
      to: n-converged
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-01-edge-7
      from: n-converged
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-robo-01-edge-8
      from: n-converged
      to: n-refine
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-robo-01-edge-9
      from: n-refine
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-robo-01-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
